newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Inchon to build stainless hot coil plant.
newsitem.headline: Inchon to build stainless hot coil plant.

text.p: South Korea's Inchon Iron and Steel Co Ltd, a unit of Hyundai Group, said on Wednesday it would build a stainless hot coil plant with annual production capacity of 450,000 tonnes by 2000.
A company statement said it would invest 800 billion won to build the plant at Poseong, southwest of Seoul.
The statement said the plant would also have facilities to make up to 150,000 tonnes of cold-rolled steel products.
The company is currently capable of making 3.7 million tonnes of mild steel and 160,000 tonnes of cold-rolled products a year.
South Korea's annual stainless hot coil demand is currently estimated at 950,000 tonnes, it said.

The statement said Pohang Iron and Steel Co Ltd was currently the only South Korean company to make stainless hot coil, producing 700,000 tonnes a year. South Korea imports about 250,000 tonnes of stainless hot coil annually.
Inchon Iron said the country's annual stainless hot coil requirements were expected to rise to between 1.25 million and 1.35 million tonnes by 2000.
